setlist.title: Beat It On Down the Line
Goin' Down the Road Feelin' Bad

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Other One** (3 reviews): Reviewer knows of no other Other One, He's Gone, Other One sandwich; exit into Greatest Story is strong; After the first verse, a lull filled by Billy erupts into a fast jazzy groove, nearing a Tiger jam before returning to the theme and spacing into He's Gone [5][6][7]
- **Comes a Time** (2 reviews): Comes a Time is singled out as a fine performance; Reviewer's first Dead show; Comes a Time was the highlight and stayed with them for twenty years [2][12]
- **Not Fade Away** (2 reviews): The Not Fade Away, Goin' Down the Road, Not Fade Away closer is called tasty; The Not Fade Away, Goin' Down the Road closer is mentioned among the highlights [3][12]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Truckin' into Drums, The Other One, He's Gone and back to The Other One is called excellent [2]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): He's Gone is called absolutely gorgeous, and The Other One is praised as killer [3]
- **Goin' Down the Road Feelin' Bad** (1 review): The jamming in Goin' Down the Road Feelin' Bad is called some of the best the reviewer has heard [11]

## The recordings

- **gd72-10-19.sbd.des.4506.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 29 songs; 177 min; rated 4.18/5 by 11 [1]. Said about its sound: Soundboard could be somewhat crisper but is still worth downloading; Soundboard sounds good [2][4]

## Around the show

- Local attendee recalls rumors that the band was considering buying the Fox Theatre as a Midwest base [8]
- Band felt comfortable and settled in the theatre across all three nights; the crowd was primed [8]
- Photos suggest the Fox Theatre must have been visually stunning [11]
- Judged slightly lacking next to the previous night's performance; soundboard less crisp than many other fall '72 recordings [3]
- Considered standard fare for the period, though played well [4]
- Compared with the 11/17 Wichita show, which also has heavy wah-wah and a strong Other One [5]
- Reviewer suggests it may not be the best show of the fall '72 tour [6]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd72-10-19.sbd.des.4506.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Soundboard transferred via a MR, to cassette, to DAT, to CDR, by DES; The recording cuts into Promised Land [1]
